list: The official 55 trophies as shown on PlayStation Network, taken 18 November 2026 from Exophase and cross-checked with PSNProfiles and TrueAchievements. Rockstar has not published an official list of its own.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and this one unlocks on its own. Work the roadmap in order: story first, then the 100% checklist, then cleanup.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy: finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing, in Chapter 1. It cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Automatic: finish Chapter 1. Before you do, meditate at Jason's house — that first meditation is the game's only missable moment. Keep a manual save at the start of every chapter, because there is no mission replay.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Automatic: finish Chapter 2.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Automatic: finish Chapter 3.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Automatic: finish Chapter 4.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Automatic: finish the final mission. Make a manual save before it — there is no mission replay and no New Game Plus.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Automatic: finish the mission Breakfast Run.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Automatic: finish the mission The Cartel Heist.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Automatic: finish the mission Child's Play.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Automatic: finish the mission Headliners.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Automatic: finish the mission VCIA Takedown.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Automatic: finish the mission Operation Savage Glory.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Attain 100% Completion. The checklist (Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion) appears after the story, but progress made earlier counts and nothing on it is missable. PowerPyx puts it at roughly 60% of true completion — most of it comes from the other trophies — and ranks it the hardest trophy in the set. Work it after the story, in Stage 2 of the roadmap.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts. PowerPyx counts 397 stunts in total: 130 Stunt Jumps, 202 Under the Bridges, 40 Knife Flights and 25 Base Jumps. Any 250 count; the 100% checklist wants 300. Mix ramp jumps in the city with bridge fly-unders while travelling.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each type of activity once. The trophy tracker counts 9 activity types — dip into each one as you meet it during the story: races, fishing, arcade games, bowling, the shooting range, drone races, meditation, hunting and challenges.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Visit the Shooting Range and gold every challenge; PowerPyx notes the golds are not too difficult, and they count toward the 70-of-80 challenges needed for 100% Completion.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every one of the 14 locations. Learn each course, then win it — races are repeatable, so retry a location until you win it.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Enter the race types as you find them across Leonida — street, off-road, boat and air races all count as different races.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Find Cal and take him on at fishing — you can retry the challenge.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game. Play any arcade game through to its end.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Automatic: finish the final mission for Andy. Do Andy's strand when it appears; stranger strands are best done during the story.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Automatic: finish the final mission for Kenton.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Automatic: finish the final mission for Billy.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Pick up stranger missions as you explore and see each strand through to its end — eight completed strands unlock it.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Automatic: finish the final mission for Randy.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Automatic: finish the final mission for Tyrone.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida — 18 spots in 10 locations, as Jason and Lucia. This is the only potentially missable trophy: PowerPyx and GTABase both flag it. The first meditation is offered at Jason's house in Chapter 1 and becomes permanently unavailable after that chapter, so meditate there before finishing Chapter 1, then visit every other spot as you find it.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Take Bret's hunt and track the unique animal he names — use binoculars to study animals, since the 100% checklist also wants 100 of 255 animals studied.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. Find cards across Leonida and finish any three sets — card spots are marked as you explore, and community maps are filling in during launch week.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. Use the WAiNK feature at 100 different spots around the map — it counts distinct locations, so keep moving.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. Challenges stack up from races, stunts, shooting and more; the 100% checklist needs 70 of 80, so keep going past 50.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. Build a 4-star wanted level while your partner is with you, then break line of sight and stay hidden until it clears.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. Rob three shops in a row with your partner beside you and keep the wanted level the whole way — plan a route of nearby shops and a fast getaway car.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Drive and encounter new vehicles — each new model you find counts. The 100% checklist wants 200 of 277 base models scanned, so keep discovering.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Trigger Combat Focus in a firefight with a group of enemies and down five before it ends — pick a busy shootout.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA. Leave the airport in a way the schedule did not plan — take a plane out yourself.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Steal a military tank (a Rhino) and drive off with it. Tanks sit out in the open at military spots — take one and drive away, and expect a 3-star wanted level.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Go in quiet — no alarms, no witnesses spotting you — and get out clean.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape. Hit five bank vaults and get away after each one — plan your escape before you go in.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. Ambush an armored truck, take its cash and lose the wanted level.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — all 52 areas. Travel the whole map; areas count as you visit them.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. Find and rob one illegal operation per gang — nine gangs, nine robberies.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. PowerPyx lists this one's unlock method as not yet known at launch — the description points to a cocktail with an ocean view on Ocean Beach, so visit the beach bars there and check the guide link for updates as players pin it down.
trophies.source: Official list · PowerPyx (method not yet known)

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. PowerPyx lists this one's unlock method as not yet known at launch — the description suggests a showroom smash-up, so check the guide link for updates as players pin it down.
trophies.source: Official list · PowerPyx (method not yet known)

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. Play a game at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley and follow through on your shots.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal. A partner moment — play through the story with your partner and this pops at the right beat; the exact trigger is not published, so keep playing.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Choices made, for better or worse. Make choices across the game — the trophy tracks the choices you make; the exact count PlayStation tracks is not published, so keep choosing and it will come.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. PowerPyx lists this one's unlock method as not yet known at launch — the name suggests succeeding on a second attempt at something; check the guide link for updates.
trophies.source: Official list · PowerPyx (method not yet known)

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? PowerPyx lists this one's unlock method as not yet known at launch — the name points to a strange encounter somewhere in Leonida; check the guide link for updates.
trophies.source: Official list · PowerPyx (method not yet known)

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. PowerPyx lists this one's unlock method as not yet known at launch — the name suggests knocking someone down with a melee attack from a moving vehicle; check the guide link for updates.
trophies.source: Official list · PowerPyx (method not yet known)

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Bring marked bills to your contacts and launder $250,000 in total — it accumulates across the game.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Spend $100,000 in total at shops — it accumulates, so just keep shopping as you play.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties — 8 in total. Buy every garage property on the map.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Register ten vehicles you own or find through the Scooter Bros app.
